eps.o: It's a big night of action on the first TNA iMPACT! of the new year. Knockouts World Champion Masha Slamovich, Jordynne Grace and Knockouts World Tag Team Champions Spitfire battle Rosemary, Tasha Steelz, and Ash & Heather By Elegance in an 8-Knockout tag team main event.
The road to Genesis continues! Joe Hendry and Rhino face off against TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth and his brother, Ryan Nemeth. Mike Santana competes in The Northern Armory Gauntlet.

It's the last stop before TNA's first pay-per-view of 2025, Genesis! Nic Nemeth and Joe Hendry go face to face ahead of their championship showdown. The Hardys battle PCO and Sami Callihan with TNA World Tag Team Title implications.
For the first time in 8 years, TNA iMPACT! is LIVE as the action emanates from the Boeing Center at Tech Port in San Antonio, TX. The Rascalz challenge Fraxiom for the NXT Tag Team Championship.

Following a historic week, the action continues on an all-new TNA iMPACT! from San Antonio, TX. For the first time since Genesis, we'll hear from the former TNA World Champion, Nic Nemeth. After his shocking return, Mustafa Ali collides with Laredo Kid.
It's a loaded TNA iMPACT! from San Antonio, TX. After entering the WWE Royal Rumble match, TNA World Champion Joe Hendry will perform a Championship Live Concert.

Two World Championships are up for grabs on an all-new TNA iMPACT! from San Antonio, TX. Joe Hendry defends the TNA World Title against Jake Something, and Savannah Evans challenges Masha Slamovich for the Knockouts World Title.
TNA iMPACT! is LIVE from Full Sail University in Orlando, FL. TNA World Champion Joe Hendry presents an Encore Championship Concert. Tessa Blanchard competes on iMPACT! for the first time in 4 years.
It's an all-new TNA iMPACT! from Full Sail University in Orlando, FL. TNA World Tag Team Champions The Hardys join forces with NXT Champion Oba Femi to battle The System.

It's an all-new TNA iMPACT! from Full Sail University in Orlando, FL. Oba Femi and Moose go face to face ahead of their NXT Championship match at WWE Roadblock. Elijah makes his TNA singles debut vs. Brian Myers.

It's an all-new TNA iMPACT! just 24 hours away from Sacrifice. Joe Hendry defends the TNA World Championship. Knockouts World Champion Masha Slamovich and Léi Yǐng Lee battle Tessa Blanchard and NXT's Cora Jade.
The fallout from Sacrifice begins. TNA World Champion Joe Hendry and Elijah battle Eddie Edwards and Brian Myers of The System. Nic and Ryan Nemeth address their shocking actions at Sacrifice.

The action continues from El Paso, TX. Leon Slater seeks revenge on Nic Nemeth in the main event. Knockouts World Champion Masha Slamovich battles NXT's Jacy Jayne. We find out what's next for TNA World Champion Joe Hendry.
The road to Rebellion rolls on from St. Joseph, MO. Knockouts World Champion Masha Slamovich, Xia Brookside and Léi Yǐng Lee battle Tessa Blanchard, and NXT's Jacy Jayne and Jazmyn Nyx.

The Total Nonstop Action continues from St. Joseph, MO. Every member of The System will be in action: Eddie Edwards battles Steve Maclin, JDC and Brian Myers take on The Rascalz, and X-Division Champion Moose locks up with Cody Deaner.

It's the Countdown to Unbreakable as TNA iMPACT! kicks off a big night of action. Leon Slater battles The System's Brian Myers. Knockouts World Tag Team Champion Heather By Elegance teams with Maggie Lee to take on NXT's Gigi Dolin and Tatum Paxley.

4-Way Match: The System (Eddie Edwards & Brian Myers) defeat The Rascalz (Trey Miguel & Zachary Wentz), The Great Hands (John Skyler & Jason Hotch) and Sinner & Saint (Travis Williams & Judas Icarus) Dani Luna defeats Jody Threat El Paso Street Fight: The Hardys (Matt & Jeff Hardy) defeat The Colóns (Eddie & Orlando Colón) Mike Santana defeats Cedric Alexander

#1 Contender (TNA Knockouts World Championship) 4-Way Match: Dani Luna defeats Indi Hartwell, Rosemary and Myla Grace Mance Warner defeats Matt Cardona John Skyler defeats Myron Reed #1 Contender (TNA Knockouts World Championship) 4-Way Match: Xia Brookside defeats Victoria Crawford, Killer Kelly and Jody Threat "If JDC wins, he gets a TNA World Championship shot": JDC defeats Eric Young
